consequence.statement: The hydrator stops using manifest-generate-paths, so environments whose hydrator behavior depended on manifest-generate-paths will see changed behavior; the evidence states no failure, rejection, or migration.
consequence.remediation: If you rely on manifest-generate-paths, verify hydrator behavior after upgrading to v3.0.0.

assertion.statement: In Argo CD v3.0.0 the hydrator no longer uses manifest-generate-paths (bugfix 35009a7d1c278c5f609160651a843d17fcf1b8ef).
